items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the amount or basis of the decision, file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Familienkasse Musterlahn, or have it recorded in person at their office, by the deadline shown.
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei: Familienkasse Musterlahn, Bahnhofsallee 40, 35576 Beispielwetzlar.

items.title: Receive Kinderzuschlag payments for Ida and Jonas
items.action: No action is needed; the Kinderzuschlag will be paid automatically each month from December 2026 through May 2027.
items.quote: für Ihre Kinder Ida und Jonas bewilligen wir Ihnen von Dezember 2026 bis Mai 2027 Kinderzuschlag von je 297,00 € im Monat.

items.title: Apply for education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe)
items.action: Submit a separate application for Bildung-und-Teilhabe benefits to your local municipality (Kommune), since this is not included automatically with this decision.
items.quote: Mit dem Bescheid erhalten Sie Leistungen für Bildung und Teilhabe; den Antrag dafür stellen Sie bei Ihrer Kommune.

data.title: Kinderzuschlag approved for Ida and Jonas
data.summary: Familienkasse Musterlahn approved Kinderzuschlag (supplementary child benefit) of €297 per month for each of your children, Ida and Jonas, for the period December 2026 through May 2027, based on your income and housing costs.
data.explanation: This is a favourable decision: the Familienkasse has approved an extra monthly benefit (Kinderzuschlag) of €297 for each child on top of regular Kindergeld, for six months. You generally don't need to do anything for the payments to start. If you think the amount or calculation is wrong, you can file an objection (Widerspruch) — the app will show the deadline for this. Separately, this decision also entitles you to education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe), but you must apply for those yourself at your local municipality. Consider consulting an advisor if you have questions about how the amount was calculated.
